question: over the whole range of per-chain calling fractions, not at three chosen points, how do precision, recall, positive-class F1 and MCC compare between the counting field and each baseline, and where does the paired difference cross zero
why_it_is_indexed_anyway: the scores were frozen by earlier reads; binarising them at 39 cut points instead of three is a new statement about the fold

plan.subject: Preregister the whole threshold axis, and forbid choosing a point on it

grid.quantity: per-chain top-q by each method's own score
grid.why_this_grid: it is the grid the training-fold operating points were chosen on, so the curve and the choice are commensurable
grid.tie_break: a stable sort of the negated score, identical to the rule the counting field deploys

what_that_forbids: moving the deployed calling fraction, which the training fold fixed at 0.09 and which this read does not revisit
reporting the best point of any curve as a headline
letting any configuration, threshold or artifact downstream read a value off this output
what_was_committed.why: a curve over 39 cut points is 39 opportunities to find a favourable one. Refusing to select from it is what keeps it a display of an already-published comparison rather than a search
what_was_committed.how_it_is_enforced: the read records that its output is consumed by no configuration, and the claims in the paper stay attached to the three operating points earlier reads fixed

why_missing_is_not_zero: a baseline whose scores are absent is recorded as absent. Scoring it as zeros would manufacture an advantage

multiplicity.why: no point on the curve carries a claim, so there is nothing to correct. Correcting 468 pointwise intervals would imply that some point of some curve was being asserted, which is exactly what this plan forbids
multiplicity.what_is_reported_instead: the interval at each cut point, labelled pointwise, plus the range of cut points over which the difference in each metric keeps one sign, which is a property of the whole curve rather than of a chosen point

conclusion: Across every calling fraction from 2% to 40%, the counting field's positive-class F1 is above P2Rank's, so the advantage reported at the deployed operating point is not an artefact of where the two methods were cut. The pointwise intervals still include zero over much of the range, so this is a statement about the sign of the difference and not about its significance.
